gridDNA: A large, full-bleed cartoon illustration occupies the top ~68% of the canvas, depicting a narrative scene with two characters. The bottom ~32% is a prominent, angled solid red colour block containing the main offer headline, subheadline, and a hero product shot, with a small legal disclaimer at the very bottom.

typeScale: headline (offer) ~10% of canvas height, subheadline (offer) ~4%, dialogue bubbles ~8%, body (disclaimer) ~2%
colourBlocking: Top ~68% is a light, illustrated background with varied colours. Bottom ~32% is a solid, vibrant red block, angled, providing high contrast for the offer text and product.
negativeSpace: Ample negative space around the characters in the top illustration, particularly in the top-left and top-right, allowing the dialogue bubbles to stand out and the narrative to breathe. The red offer block is dense but uses high contrast for readability.
eyePath: Left character's speech bubble -> Right character's speech bubble -> Offer Headline -> Product -> Offer Subheadline -> Disclaimer.
whyItWins: The layout effectively uses an engaging narrative illustration to capture initial attention, then transitions sharply to a high-contrast, prominent offer block with a clear product visual, creating a strong and memorable value proposition.
